topic: Can the filter's suppression of 19th harmonics improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations?
consensus_response: Suppressing 19th harmonics reduces interference, improving capacity and power allocation efficiency. This minimizes out-of-band emissions from nonlinear HPAs, allowing tighter frequency reuse. However, filter complexity introduces trade-offs, such as group delay ripple and amplitude distortion, affecting signal quality.
reference_context: SatCom systems face challenges with nonlinear distortions and intermodulation products, impacting performance and efficiency.
